stats.notes: Baseline from IPEDS fall 2024 (College Navigator percentages; exact counts from the NCES ADM2024 file via the Urban Institute Education Data Portal). Admission is effectively open (99.7% admitted). No Common Data Set was found on MGA's institutional research pages, so international applicants/admits, GPA, SAT total and admission factors are not included. SAT/ACT percentiles cover enrolled first-time students who submitted scores (SAT 18%, ACT 7%).
